rules: Bank-to-HOME transfer uses an official HOME Moving Key when the 3DS path is used.
After Bank service ends, Bank-to-HOME transfer will no longer be available.
LegacyBox must not claim a Bank transfer occurred merely because local PKM metadata resembles a transferred Pokémon.

acceptance_semantics.means: The official Bank/Transporter service accepted and moved the Pokémon at that time.
acceptance_semantics.does_not_mean: The original encounter was historically legitimate.
acceptance_semantics.legacybox_rule: Bank acceptance may upgrade migration evidence, never origin evidence.

home_tracker.local_meaning: Presence of a tracker can indicate the Pokémon has passed through HOME, but a local tool cannot validate whether the tracker value is genuine or matches HOME server history.
home_tracker.pkhex_capability: PKHeX can determine when a tracker is required and can detect zero/missing tracker fields, but cannot validate the actual tracker value against HOME server data.
legacybox_rules: Never fabricate or copy a HOME tracker.
Only record tracker_present after observing a concrete post-HOME PK8+ snapshot.
Hash and preserve the post-HOME snapshot used as evidence.
Treat server-side history as unverifiable locally.
A successful HOME upload does not upgrade generated origin evidence to historically legitimate.
reverse_engineered_notes: For pre-Switch Pokémon entering HOME through Bank, reverse-engineering indicates HOME initializes a SWSH child data block in addition to core HOME data.
HOME tracker values can change across uploads; LegacyBox therefore never uses the raw tracker as a permanent archive identifier.
Immutable values associated with HOME history should not be edited after HOME entry when provenance preservation is the goal.

terminology.legal: The local PKM satisfies known structural/encounter/transfer constraints.
terminology.legitimate: The Pokémon was actually obtained and moved through the claimed official historical process.
terminology.home_accepted: HOME accepted an upload or official move at that time; this is not equivalent to proving original legitimacy.
terminology.tracker_observed: A nonzero HOME tracker was observed in a post-HOME PK8+ snapshot; the tracker cannot be authenticated locally.
